{"content":"# gh-1521 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: `browser-ext.yml` app-build leg (`Playwright e2e (panel app build)`, `workflow_dispatch` with `--with-app`) fails exactly 2 tests — `mail visible › inbound mail … duplicates stay deduped` (toHaveCount mismatch) and `steer-stream › E2E-steer-indicator … when the message lands` (`page.fill: Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

**Root cause**: Both tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but with an app bundle built (`browser_ext/panel/app/index.html` present — exactly what `--with-app` produces) `panel.js`'s v2.1 hosting loader HEAD-probes the bundle and `location.replace`s the panel to the Flutter web app (`browser_ext/e2e/helpers.ts: awaitPanelSettled` waits for `**/panel/app/index.html`). The Flutter app renders chat to canvas — the legacy selectors never resolve there:

1. `mail-visible.spec.ts` test 1 polls `.bubble.user` on the app page → count stays 0 → `toHaveCount(1)` mismatch ("count drift"). The duplicate pushMail dedup logic itself is fine (AC18 `MailDeduper` in `browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_frames.dart`; app-branch rendering is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests`).
2. `steer-stream.spec.ts` `E2E-steer-indicator` fills `#prompt` on the app page → the composer never appears; the surface dies mid-wait (`Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

The repo's established convention for exactly this situation is `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy composer only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` — used by `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs), whose comments document the deterministic-timeout failure mode. `mail-visible.spec.ts` already IMPORTS `appBundlePresent` (unused — the skip was dropped in a past edit) but never calls it; `steer-stream.spec.ts` never got it for its panel-driven test.

**Impact**: App-build e2e leg red ×2 runs; default (lean) leg green because no bundle → no redirect → legacy DOM renders.

**Fix approach**: Restore the convention in the two specs: skip the legacy-DOM assertions when `appBundlePresent` (describe-level for mail-visible — both its tests target the legacy surface contract; test-level for the one panel-driven steer test). No product-code change: the messaging/dedup contract is unchanged, and the app branch is covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` mail tests (asserted dedup-by-message-id invariant at unit level: one bubble per delivery, AC18).

{"content":"# gh-1521 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: `browser-ext.yml` app-build leg (`Playwright e2e (panel app build)`, `workflow_dispatch` with `--with-app`) fails exactly 2 tests — `mail visible › inbound mail … duplicates stay deduped` (toHaveCount mismatch) and `steer-stream › E2E-steer-indicator … when the message lands` (`page.fill: Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

**Root cause**: Both tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but with an app bundle built (`browser_ext/panel/app/index.html` present — exactly what `--with-app` produces) `panel.js`'s v2.1 hosting loader HEAD-probes the bundle and `location.replace`s the panel to the Flutter web app (`browser_ext/e2e/helpers.ts: awaitPanelSettled` waits for `**/panel/app/index.html`). The Flutter app renders chat to canvas — the legacy selectors never resolve there:

1. `mail-visible.spec.ts` test 1 polls `.bubble.user` on the app page → count stays 0 → `toHaveCount(1)` mismatch ("count drift"). The duplicate pushMail dedup logic itself is fine (AC18 `MailDeduper` in `browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_frames.dart`; app-branch rendering is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests`).
2. `steer-stream.spec.ts` `E2E-steer-indicator` fills `#prompt` on the app page → the composer never appears; the surface dies mid-wait (`Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

The repo's established convention for exactly this situation is `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy composer only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` — used by `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs), whose comments document the deterministic-timeout failure mode. `mail-visible.spec.ts` already IMPORTS `appBundlePresent` (unused — the skip was dropped in a past edit) but never calls it; `steer-stream.spec.ts` never got it for its panel-driven test.

**Impact**: App-build e2e leg red ×2 runs; default (lean) leg green because no bundle → no redirect → legacy DOM renders.

**Fix approach**: Restore the convention in the two specs: skip the legacy-DOM assertions when `appBundlePresent` (describe-level for mail-visible — both its tests target the legacy surface contract; test-level for the one panel-driven steer test). No product-code change: the messaging/dedup contract is unchanged, and the app branch is covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` mail tests (asserted dedup-by-message-id invariant at unit level: one bubble per delivery, AC18).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug).

{"content":"# gh-1521 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: `browser-ext.yml` app-build leg (`Playwright e2e (panel app build)`, `workflow_dispatch` with `--with-app`) fails exactly 2 tests — `mail visible › inbound mail … duplicates stay deduped` (toHaveCount mismatch) and `steer-stream › E2E-steer-indicator … when the message lands` (`page.fill: Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

**Root cause**: Both tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but with an app bundle built (`browser_ext/panel/app/index.html` present — exactly what `--with-app` produces) `panel.js`'s v2.1 hosting loader HEAD-probes the bundle and `location.replace`s the panel to the Flutter web app (`browser_ext/e2e/helpers.ts: awaitPanelSettled` waits for `**/panel/app/index.html`). The Flutter app renders chat to canvas — the legacy selectors never resolve there:

1. `mail-visible.spec.ts` test 1 polls `.bubble.user` on the app page → count stays 0 → `toHaveCount(1)` mismatch ("count drift"). The duplicate pushMail dedup logic itself is fine (AC18 `MailDeduper` in `browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_frames.dart`; app-branch rendering is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests`).
2. `steer-stream.spec.ts` `E2E-steer-indicator` fills `#prompt` on the app page → the composer never appears; the surface dies mid-wait (`Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

The repo's established convention for exactly this situation is `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy composer only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` — used by `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs), whose comments document the deterministic-timeout failure mode. `mail-visible.spec.ts` already IMPORTS `appBundlePresent` (unused — the skip was dropped in a past edit) but never calls it; `steer-stream.spec.ts` never got it for its panel-driven test.

**Impact**: App-build e2e leg red ×2 runs; default (lean) leg green because no bundle → no redirect → legacy DOM renders.

**Fix approach**: Restore the convention in the two specs: skip the legacy-DOM assertions when `appBundlePresent` (describe-level for mail-visible — both its tests target the legacy surface contract; test-level for the one panel-driven steer test). No product-code change: the messaging/dedup contract is unchanged, and the app branch is covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` mail tests (asserted dedup-by-message-id invariant at unit level: one bubble per delivery, AC18).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug).

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: `browser-ext.yml` app-build leg (`Playwright e2e (panel app build)`, `workflow_dispatch` with `--with-app`) fails exactly 2 tests — `mail visible › inbound mail … duplicates stay deduped` (toHaveCount mismatch) and `steer-stream › E2E-steer-indicator … when the message lands` (`page.fill: Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

**Root cause**: Both tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but with an app bundle built (`browser_ext/panel/app/index.html` present — exactly what `--with-app` produces) `panel.js`'s v2.1 hosting loader HEAD-probes the bundle and `location.replace`s the panel to the Flutter web app (`browser_ext/e2e/helpers.ts: awaitPanelSettled` waits for `**/panel/app/index.html`). The Flutter app renders chat to canvas — the legacy selectors never resolve there:

1. `mail-visible.spec.ts` test 1 polls `.bubble.user` on the app page → count stays 0 → `toHaveCount(1)` mismatch ("count drift"). The duplicate pushMail dedup logic itself is fine (AC18 `MailDeduper` in `browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_frames.dart`; app-branch rendering is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests`).
2. `steer-stream.spec.ts` `E2E-steer-indicator` fills `#prompt` on the app page → the composer never appears; the surface dies mid-wait (`Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

The repo's established convention for exactly this situation is `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy composer only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` — used by `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs), whose comments document the deterministic-timeout failure mode. `mail-visible.spec.ts` already IMPORTS `appBundlePresent` (unused — the skip was dropped in a past edit) but never calls it; `steer-stream.spec.ts` never got it for its panel-driven test.

**Impact**: App-build e2e leg red ×2 runs; default (lean) leg green because no bundle → no redirect → legacy DOM renders.

**Fix approach**: Restore the convention in the two specs: skip the legacy-DOM assertions when `appBundlePresent` (describe-level for mail-visible — both its tests target the legacy surface contract; test-level for the one panel-driven steer test). No product-code change: the messaging/dedup contract is unchanged, and the app branch is covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` mail tests (asserted dedup-by-message-id invariant at unit level: one bubble per delivery, AC18).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug).

{"content":"# gh-1521 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: `browser-ext.yml` app-build leg (`Playwright e2e (panel app build)`, `workflow_dispatch` with `--with-app`) fails exactly 2 tests — `mail visible › inbound mail … duplicates stay deduped` (toHaveCount mismatch) and `steer-stream › E2E-steer-indicator … when the message lands` (`page.fill: Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

**Root cause**: Both tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but with an app bundle built (`browser_ext/panel/app/index.html` present — exactly what `--with-app` produces) `panel.js`'s v2.1 hosting loader HEAD-probes the bundle and `location.replace`s the panel to the Flutter web app (`browser_ext/e2e/helpers.ts: awaitPanelSettled` waits for `**/panel/app/index.html`). The Flutter app renders chat to canvas — the legacy selectors never resolve there:

1. `mail-visible.spec.ts` test 1 polls `.bubble.user` on the app page → count stays 0 → `toHaveCount(1)` mismatch ("count drift"). The duplicate pushMail dedup logic itself is fine (AC18 `MailDeduper` in `browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_frames.dart`; app-branch rendering is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests`).
2. `steer-stream.spec.ts` `E2E-steer-indicator` fills `#prompt` on the app page → the composer never appears; the surface dies mid-wait (`Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

The repo's established convention for exactly this situation is `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy composer only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` — used by `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs), whose comments document the deterministic-timeout failure mode. `mail-visible.spec.ts` already IMPORTS `appBundlePresent` (unused — the skip was dropped in a past edit) but never calls it; `steer-stream.spec.ts` never got it for its panel-driven test.

**Impact**: App-build e2e leg red ×2 runs; default (lean) leg green because no bundle → no redirect → legacy DOM renders.

**Fix approach**: Restore the convention in the two specs: skip the legacy-DOM assertions when `appBundlePresent` (describe-level for mail-visible — both its tests target the legacy surface contract; test-level for the one panel-driven steer test). No product-code change: the messaging/dedup contract is unchanged, and the app branch is covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` mail tests (asserted dedup-by-message-id invariant at unit level: one bubble per delivery, AC18).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug).

{"content":"# gh-1521 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: `browser-ext.yml` app-build leg (`Playwright e2e (panel app build)`, `workflow_dispatch` with `--with-app`) fails exactly 2 tests — `mail visible › inbound mail … duplicates stay deduped` (toHaveCount mismatch) and `steer-stream › E2E-steer-indicator … when the message lands` (`page.fill: Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

**Root cause**: Both tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but with an app bundle built (`browser_ext/panel/app/index.html` present — exactly what `--with-app` produces) `panel.js`'s v2.1 hosting loader HEAD-probes the bundle and `location.replace`s the panel to the Flutter web app (`browser_ext/e2e/helpers.ts: awaitPanelSettled` waits for `**/panel/app/index.html`). The Flutter app renders chat to canvas — the legacy selectors never resolve there:

1. `mail-visible.spec.ts` test 1 polls `.bubble.user` on the app page → count stays 0 → `toHaveCount(1)` mismatch ("count drift"). The duplicate pushMail dedup logic itself is fine (AC18 `MailDeduper` in `browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_frames.dart`; app-branch rendering is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests`).
2. `steer-stream.spec.ts` `E2E-steer-indicator` fills `#prompt` on the app page → the composer never appears; the surface dies mid-wait (`Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

The repo's established convention for exactly this situation is `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy composer only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` — used by `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs), whose comments document the deterministic-timeout failure mode. `mail-visible.spec.ts` already IMPORTS `appBundlePresent` (unused — the skip was dropped in a past edit) but never calls it; `steer-stream.spec.ts` never got it for its panel-driven test.

**Impact**: App-build e2e leg red ×2 runs; default (lean) leg green because no bundle → no redirect → legacy DOM renders.

**Fix approach**: Restore the convention in the two specs: skip the legacy-DOM assertions when `appBundlePresent` (describe-level for mail-visible — both its tests target the legacy surface contract; test-level for the one panel-driven steer test). No product-code change: the messaging/dedup contract is unchanged, and the app branch is covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` mail tests (asserted dedup-by-message-id invariant at unit level: one bubble per delivery, AC18).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug).

{"content":"# gh-1521 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: `browser-ext.yml` app-build leg (`Playwright e2e (panel app build)`, `workflow_dispatch` with `--with-app`) fails exactly 2 tests — `mail visible › inbound mail … duplicates stay deduped` (toHaveCount mismatch) and `steer-stream › E2E-steer-indicator … when the message lands` (`page.fill: Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

**Root cause**: Both tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but with an app bundle built (`browser_ext/panel/app/index.html` present — exactly what `--with-app` produces) `panel.js`'s v2.1 hosting loader HEAD-probes the bundle and `location.replace`s the panel to the Flutter web app (`browser_ext/e2e/helpers.ts: awaitPanelSettled` waits for `**/panel/app/index.html`). The Flutter app renders chat to canvas — the legacy selectors never resolve there:

1. `mail-visible.spec.ts` test 1 polls `.bubble.user` on the app page → count stays 0 → `toHaveCount(1)` mismatch ("count drift"). The duplicate pushMail dedup logic itself is fine (AC18 `MailDeduper` in `browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_frames.dart`; app-branch rendering is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests`).
2. `steer-stream.spec.ts` `E2E-steer-indicator` fills `#prompt` on the app page → the composer never appears; the surface dies mid-wait (`Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

The repo's established convention for exactly this situation is `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy composer only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` — used by `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs), whose comments document the deterministic-timeout failure mode. `mail-visible.spec.ts` already IMPORTS `appBundlePresent` (unused — the skip was dropped in a past edit) but never calls it; `steer-stream.spec.ts` never got it for its panel-driven test.

**Impact**: App-build e2e leg red ×2 runs; default (lean) leg green because no bundle → no redirect → legacy DOM renders.

**Fix approach**: Restore the convention in the two specs: skip the legacy-DOM assertions when `appBundlePresent` (describe-level for mail-visible — both its tests target the legacy surface contract; test-level for the one panel-driven steer test). No product-code change: the messaging/dedup contract is unchanged, and the app branch is covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` mail tests (asserted dedup-by-message-id invariant at unit level: one bubble per delivery, AC18).

{"content":"# gh-1521 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: `browser-ext.yml` app-build leg (`Playwright e2e (panel app build)`, `workflow_dispatch` with `--with-app`) fails exactly 2 tests — `mail visible › inbound mail … duplicates stay deduped` (toHaveCount mismatch) and `steer-stream › E2E-steer-indicator … when the message lands` (`page.fill: Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

**Root cause**: Both tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but with an app bundle built (`browser_ext/panel/app/index.html` present — exactly what `--with-app` produces) `panel.js`'s v2.1 hosting loader HEAD-probes the bundle and `location.replace`s the panel to the Flutter web app (`browser_ext/e2e/helpers.ts: awaitPanelSettled` waits for `**/panel/app/index.html`). The Flutter app renders chat to canvas — the legacy selectors never resolve there:

1. `mail-visible.spec.ts` test 1 polls `.bubble.user` on the app page → count stays 0 → `toHaveCount(1)` mismatch ("count drift"). The duplicate pushMail dedup logic itself is fine (AC18 `MailDeduper` in `browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_frames.dart`; app-branch rendering is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests`).
2. `steer-stream.spec.ts` `E2E-steer-indicator` fills `#prompt` on the app page → the composer never appears; the surface dies mid-wait (`Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

The repo's established convention for exactly this situation is `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy composer only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` — used by `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs), whose comments document the deterministic-timeout failure mode. `mail-visible.spec.ts` already IMPORTS `appBundlePresent` (unused — the skip was dropped in a past edit) but never calls it; `steer-stream.spec.ts` never got it for its panel-driven test.

**Impact**: App-build e2e leg red ×2 runs; default (lean) leg green because no bundle → no redirect → legacy DOM renders.

**Fix approach**: Restore the convention in the two specs: skip the legacy-DOM assertions when `appBundlePresent` (describe-level for mail-visible — both its tests target the legacy surface contract; test-level for the one panel-driven steer test). No product-code change: the messaging/dedup contract is unchanged, and the app branch is covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` mail tests (asserted dedup-by-message-id invariant at unit level: one bubble per delivery, AC18).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug).

{"content":"# gh-1521 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: `browser-ext.yml` app-build leg (`Playwright e2e (panel app build)`, `workflow_dispatch` with `--with-app`) fails exactly 2 tests — `mail visible › inbound mail … duplicates stay deduped` (toHaveCount mismatch) and `steer-stream › E2E-steer-indicator … when the message lands` (`page.fill: Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

**Root cause**: Both tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but with an app bundle built (`browser_ext/panel/app/index.html` present — exactly what `--with-app` produces) `panel.js`'s v2.1 hosting loader HEAD-probes the bundle and `location.replace`s the panel to the Flutter web app (`browser_ext/e2e/helpers.ts: awaitPanelSettled` waits for `**/panel/app/index.html`). The Flutter app renders chat to canvas — the legacy selectors never resolve there:

1. `mail-visible.spec.ts` test 1 polls `.bubble.user` on the app page → count stays 0 → `toHaveCount(1)` mismatch ("count drift"). The duplicate pushMail dedup logic itself is fine (AC18 `MailDeduper` in `browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_frames.dart`; app-branch rendering is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests`).
2. `steer-stream.spec.ts` `E2E-steer-indicator` fills `#prompt` on the app page → the composer never appears; the surface dies mid-wait (`Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

The repo's established convention for exactly this situation is `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy composer only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` — used by `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs), whose comments document the deterministic-timeout failure mode. `mail-visible.spec.ts` already IMPORTS `appBundlePresent` (unused — the skip was dropped in a past edit) but never calls it; `steer-stream.spec.ts` never got it for its panel-driven test.

**Impact**: App-build e2e leg red ×2 runs; default (lean) leg green because no bundle → no redirect → legacy DOM renders.

**Fix approach**: Restore the convention in the two specs: skip the legacy-DOM assertions when `appBundlePresent` (describe-level for mail-visible — both its tests target the legacy surface contract; test-level for the one panel-driven steer test). No product-code change: the messaging/dedup contract is unchanged, and the app branch is covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` mail tests (asserted dedup-by-message-id invariant at unit level: one bubble per delivery, AC18).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug).

{"content":"# gh-1521 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: `browser-ext.yml` app-build leg (`Playwright e2e (panel app build)`, `workflow_dispatch` with `--with-app`) fails exactly 2 tests — `mail visible › inbound mail … duplicates stay deduped` (toHaveCount mismatch) and `steer-stream › E2E-steer-indicator … when the message lands` (`page.fill: Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

**Root cause**: Both tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but with an app bundle built (`browser_ext/panel/app/index.html` present — exactly what `--with-app` produces) `panel.js`'s v2.1 hosting loader HEAD-probes the bundle and `location.replace`s the panel to the Flutter web app (`browser_ext/e2e/helpers.ts: awaitPanelSettled` waits for `**/panel/app/index.html`). The Flutter app renders chat to canvas — the legacy selectors never resolve there:

1. `mail-visible.spec.ts` test 1 polls `.bubble.user` on the app page → count stays 0 → `toHaveCount(1)` mismatch ("count drift"). The duplicate pushMail dedup logic itself is fine (AC18 `MailDeduper` in `browser_ext/dart/src/dap/dap_frames.dart`; app-branch rendering is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests`).
2. `steer-stream.spec.ts` `E2E-steer-indicator` fills `#prompt` on the app page → the composer never appears; the surface dies mid-wait (`Target page, context or browser has been closed`).

The repo's established convention for exactly this situation is `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy composer only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` — used by `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs), whose comments document the deterministic-timeout failure mode. `mail-visible.spec.ts` already IMPORTS `appBundlePresent` (unused — the skip was dropped in a past edit) but never calls it; `steer-stream.spec.ts` never got it for its panel-driven test.

**Impact**: App-build e2e leg red ×2 runs; default (lean) leg green because no bundle → no redirect → legacy DOM renders.

**Fix approach**: Restore the convention in the two specs: skip the legacy-DOM assertions when `appBundlePresent` (describe-level for mail-visible — both its tests target the legacy surface contract; test-level for the one panel-driven steer test). No product-code change: the messaging/dedup contract is unchanged, and the app branch is covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` mail tests (asserted dedup-by-message-id invariant at unit level: one bubble per delivery, AC18).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug).

arguments.content:
### Root Cause
The two failing tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but the app-build leg (`--with-app`) leaves `browser_ext/panel/app/` in place, so `panel.js`'s hosting loader redirects the panel to the Flutter web app — a canvas surface where those selectors never resolve. Mail dedup itself was never broken: the AC18 `MailDeduper` contract holds, and the app branch is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests` (incl. the dedup-by-message-id invariant, 49/49 green).

### Fix
- `browser_ext/e2e/mail-visible.spec.ts`: `test.skip(appBundlePresent, …)` on the legacy-transcript test (`appBundlePresent` was already imported but unused — the skip had been dropped). `AC3` keeps running in app mode (SW seams only).
- `browser_ext/e2e/steer-stream.spec.ts`: same skip on `E2E-steer-indicator`, the one test driving the legacy composer.
- This is the established repo convention — `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` carry the identical skip with the same rationale; no product code changed.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: with the fix stashed and a real `--with-app` build, both ticket failures reproduced exactly (incl. the `page.fill: Target page… has been closed` error-context slug).
- App leg: `mail-visible` + `steer-stream` → 4 passed, 2 skipped; full playwright suite → 32 passed / 7 skipped (2 remaining `dap.spec.ts` failures are the environment-dependent CLI-agent+hub leg, unrelated to this change).
- Legacy leg (no bundle): all 6 tests pass — skips don't fire.
- `flutter test test/relay_agent_service_test.dart`: 49/49 (app-branch mail/dedup coverage).

### Notes
- No messaging-layer or dedup semantic changed — the ticket's "dedup not holding" symptom was a locator count of 0 on the canvas app page, not a dedup regression.
- The skip is conditional on the bundle file (same probe the panel itself uses), so local lean checkouts and the default CI leg still run both tests fully.

{"content":"### Root Cause
The two failing tests assert against the LEGACY panel DOM (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but the app-build leg (`--with-app`) leaves `browser_ext/panel/app/` in place, so `panel.js`'s hosting loader redirects the panel to the Flutter web app — a canvas surface where those selectors never resolve. Mail dedup itself was never broken: the AC18 `MailDeduper` contract holds, and the app branch is unit-covered by `flutter_app/test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` `_mailTests` (incl. the dedup-by-message-id invariant, 49/49 green).

### Fix
- `browser_ext/e2e/mail-visible.spec.ts`: `test.skip(appBundlePresent, …)` on the legacy-transcript test (`appBundlePresent` was already imported but unused — the skip had been dropped). `AC3` keeps running in app mode (SW seams only).
- `browser_ext/e2e/steer-stream.spec.ts`: same skip on `E2E-steer-indicator`, the one test driving the legacy composer.
- This is the established repo convention — `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` carry the identical skip with the same rationale; no product code changed.

### Test Coverage
- RED first: with the fix stashed and a real `--with-app` build, both ticket failures reproduced exactly (incl. the `page.fill: Target page… has been closed` error-context slug).
- App leg: `mail-visible` + `steer-stream` → 4 passed, 2 skipped; full playwright suite → 32 passed / 7 skipped (2 remaining `dap.spec.ts` failures are the environment-dependent CLI-agent+hub leg, unrelated to this change).
- Legacy leg (no bundle): all 6 tests pass — skips don't fire.
- `flutter test test/relay_agent_service_test.dart`: 49/49 (app-branch mail/dedup coverage).

### Notes
- No messaging-layer or dedup semantic changed — the ticket's "dedup not holding" symptom was a locator count of 0 on the canvas app page, not a dedup regression.
- The skip is conditional on the bundle file (same probe the panel itself uses), so local lean checkouts and the default CI leg still run both tests fully.

### Notes
- No messaging-layer or dedup semantic changed — the ticket's "dedup not holding" symptom was a locator count of 0 on the canvas app page, not a dedup regression.

Done. Summary of the gh-1521 fix:

## Root cause
Not a messaging/dedup regression at all. The two red tests assert against the **legacy panel DOM** (`#transcript .bubble.user`, `#prompt`, `#sendPrompt`, `.bubble.steer`), but the failing CI leg is the `--with-app` dispatch build — with `browser_ext/panel/app/` present, `panel.js`'s hosting loader redirects the panel to the Flutter web app (canvas surface), where those selectors never resolve. Hence the "count drift" (locator count 0) and the `page.fill: Target page… has been closed` composer failure. The AC18 dedup logic (`MailDeduper`) was never broken.

The tell: `mail-visible.spec.ts` already imported `appBundlePresent` but never used it — the skip had been dropped. `panel-focus.spec.ts` and `paste.spec.ts` (the other legacy-DOM specs) carry exactly this skip with documented rationale; the spec's own header says the app branch is "covered at unit level by flutter_app relay tests."

## Fix (committed as `198f6a6`, test-only, 20 lines)
- `mail-visible.spec.ts`: `test.skip(appBundlePresent, 'legacy transcript only — the app build redirects the panel to app/')` on the bubble-assertion test (the `AC3` test drives only SW seams and keeps running in app mode).
- `steer-stream.spec.ts`: same skip on `E2E-steer-indicator`, the one test driving the legacy composer.

## Verification
- **RED first**: fix stashed + real `--with-app` build → both ticket failures reproduced exactly, including the identical `380a2…when-the-message-lands` error-context slug.
- **App leg**: 4 passed / 2 skipped on the touched specs; full playwright suite 32 passed / 7 skipped (2 remaining `dap.spec.ts` failures are the environment-dependent CLI-agent+hub leg, unrelated — zero coupling to the edited files, green in the ticket's CI runs).
- **Legacy leg** (bundle removed): all 6 tests pass — skips don't fire.
- `flutter test test/relay_agent_service_test.dart` (app-branch mail + dedup-by-message-id coverage): 49/49.

`outputs/rca.md` and `outputs/response.md` are written; working tree clean, no stray artifacts (test-results/panel app are gitignored).
